items.title: 🇵🇭BUWAN NG WIKA 2026 | Pagdiriwang ng Wikang Filipino at Kulturang Pilipino! 🇵🇭
items.description: 🎉 Naging makulay at masaya ang ating paaralan sa pagdiriwang ng Buwan ng Wika! 📚Ipinamalas ng ating mga mag-aaral at guro ang pagmamalaki sa kulturang Pilipino sa pamamagitan ng pagsusuot ng mga tradisyonal na kasuotang Pilipino.

items.title: A NEW MILESTONE FOR THE DELIVERER! 📰
items.description: It’s been a long time coming! We proudly congratulate our campus journalists who qualified for the Division Schools Press Conference 2026–2027, happening on September 5–6, 2026.

Last week, our Junior High School students gathered for a meaningful fellowship centered on “Growing Through Prayer.” 🙏 A time to connect, reflect, and be reminded of the importance of growing closer to God through prayer
items.title: JHS Fellowship Highlights | August 12

items.description: Our student writers are taking part in the 2026 District Training Workshop, sharpening their skills in News Writing, Feature Writing, Sports Writing, Cartooning, and Photojournalism. It is a great opportunity for our young journalists to learn, practice, and grow as responsible storytellers who use their talents to inform and inspire.
